node_shape.inputs: port name to earlier node ID; variadic ports take an ordered ID array
node_shape.params: explicit operator arguments; take precedence over bindings
node_shape.bindings: parameter name to a declared runtime.<field> path
node_shape.return: the document has exactly one {"node": <RankedAnswer node ID>}

auto: Allowed only for a parameter declaring a named estimator; estimators receive reference-window-only data.
dag_depth: Configured maximum number of operator nodes on a dependency path. The verifier reports measured_graph_depth separately.
acceptance: Primary component identity in top 3; component-plus-predicted-source-category is secondary. Unknown category is null.
identity: EntityRef preserves role plus original identifier. Acceptance and final-lead dedup strip/casefold identifiers only; they do not infer aliases.
